statements.text: A self-organizing harmonic mode is a metastable synchronous complex of effective connectivity: an attractor and eigenmode of the system's dynamics whose boundaries depend on the network over which synchronization occurs. The term generalizes Atasoy's connectome harmonics to local standing wave descriptions of self-organizing dynamics.

sources.quote: IWMT proposes a mechanism by which complexes of integrated information and global workspaces may emerge as metastable synchronous complexes of effective connectivity, or selforganizing harmonic modes (SOHMs).
SOHMs represent a generalization of Selen Atasoy’s “connectome harmonics” approach to modelling neuroimaging data
